name: Saga

flag.description: A white six-petalled camphor flower with red stamens at its heart on a dark green field.
flag.symbolism: The camphor flower is the prefectural flower; the white petals stand for fairness and cleanliness, the red stamens for sincerity and passion.

hook: Saga's white camphor flower on dark green has a red heart; Miyagi's white emblem on dark green is all white.
trivia: Arita in Saga has made porcelain since the early 1600s.
The Yoshinogari site is one of Japan's largest Yayoi-era settlements.
